def wls_log_forecast(halflife=18):
    regdf=df.copy()
    regdf['t']=np.arange(len(regdf))
    regdf['month']=regdf.index.month.astype(str)
    X=pd.get_dummies(regdf[['t','month']], columns=['month'], drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    X=sm.add_constant(X)
    age=(len(regdf)-1 - regdf['t'])
    weights=0.5**(age/halflife)
    res=sm.WLS(np.log(regdf['sales_units']), X, weights=weights).fit()
    fut=pd.DataFrame(index=future_idx); fut['t']=np.arange(len(regdf), len(regdf)+3); fut['month']=fut.index.month.astype(str)
    Xf=pd.get_dummies(fut[['t','month']], columns=['month'], drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    Xf=Xf.reindex(columns=X.columns.drop('const'), fill_value=0)
    Xf=sm.add_constant(Xf, has_constant='add')
    sf=res.get_prediction(Xf).summary_frame(alpha=0.1)
    return np.exp(sf.iloc[-1]), res

def forecast_series_wls(series, log=False, halflife=18):
    tmp=pd.DataFrame({'y':series})
    tmp['t']=np.arange(len(tmp)); tmp['month']=tmp.index.month.astype(str)
    X=pd.get_dummies(tmp[['t','month']], columns=['month'], drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    X=sm.add_constant(X)
    age=len(tmp)-1-tmp['t']; weights=0.5**(age/halflife)
    yy=np.log(tmp['y']) if log else tmp['y']
    res=sm.WLS(yy, X, weights=weights).fit()
    fut=pd.DataFrame(index=future_idx); fut['t']=np.arange(len(tmp), len(tmp)+3); fut['month']=fut.index.month.astype(str)
    Xf=pd.get_dummies(fut[['t','month']], columns=['month'], drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    Xf=Xf.reindex(columns=X.columns.drop('const'), fill_value=0)
    Xf=sm.add_constant(Xf, has_constant='add')
    pred=res.get_prediction(Xf).summary_frame(alpha=0.1)
    if log:
        pred=np.exp(pred)
    return pred, res

def wls_log_train_predict(train, h=3, hl=18):
    tmp=pd.DataFrame({'y':train})
    tmp['t']=np.arange(len(tmp)); tmp['month']=tmp.index.month.astype(str)
    X=pd.get_dummies(tmp[['t','month']], columns=['month'], drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    X=sm.add_constant(X)
    weights=0.5**((len(tmp)-1-tmp['t'])/hl)
    res=sm.WLS(np.log(tmp['y']), X, weights=weights).fit()
    fut_idx=pd.date_range(train.index[-1]+pd.offsets.MonthBegin(1), periods=h, freq='MS')
    ff=pd.DataFrame(index=fut_idx); ff['t']=np.arange(len(tmp), len(tmp)+h); ff['month']=ff.index.month.astype(str)
    Xff=pd.get_dummies(ff[['t','month']], columns=['month'], drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    Xff=Xff.reindex(columns=X.columns.drop('const'), fill_value=0)
    Xff=sm.add_constant(Xff, has_constant='add')
    return float(np.exp(res.predict(Xff).iloc[-1]))
